title: citrus medica var. sarcodactylis
intro: Citrus medica var. sarcodactylis, commonly known as Fingered Citron or Buddha's Hand, is a unique, citron variety characterized by its finger-like, fingerless branches. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and improving immune function due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fingered Citron include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Fingered Citron include flavonoids, limonoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
